basis.rule: Rule: group the military-style rows (Land_Mil_*, Land_Tisy_*, Land_Medical_Tent*) into clusters by single linkage at 250 m; keep clusters with at least 6 rows and fewer than 25 percent tents; around each non-tent row try 8 compass bearings at 20 m and 28 m; a site must be within 100 m of the cluster centre, at least 12 m from every vanilla row, have at least 3 vanilla rows within 60 m whose heights span at most 1.2 m (flat ground assumption; y is their median); choose the sites nearest the centre, pairs at least 15 m apart. Class cycles through the Big1 tent family, yaw alternates 0 and 180 (the only yaws that do not depend on the unverified sign convention).
